title: Position: Trustworthy AI Suffers from Invariance Conflicts and Causality is the Solution

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation using a hypothetical structural causal model (SCM) to block direct and proxy-mediated discriminatory pathways (e.g., via insurance type) in a hospital readmission prediction scenario.

Theoretical discussion and literature review of causal debiasing methods, such as causal representation learning and counterfactual data augmentation, to separate meaningful causal features from spurious gender correlations.
